# Medical

This folder catalogs standardized medical classification frameworks used to stratify or categorize clinical data within the corpus. It currently contains the Montreal classification, which provides an international standard for the age-based stratification of patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). These systems are essential for standardizing epidemiological data and quality indicators across healthcare registries like the Danish IBD quality database (DANIBD).

## Pages

- [[montreal|Montreal]] — An international framework used to calculate and stratify the age of IBD patients in Danish national quality reports.
